messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Working conditions and Occupational health in Belgium, Denmark, Germany, Greece, Spain, Finland, France, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Austria, Portugal, Sweden, United Kingdom, Bulgaria, Cyprus, Czech Republic, Estonia, Hungary, Latvia, Lithuania, Malta, Poland, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Turkey, Croatia, Switzerland, Norway, Albania, Iceland, Montenegro, North Macedonia, and Serbia during the 2010s, matching this research need: European establishment-level survey data on occupational safety and health management, especially psychosocial risks like stress, violence and harassment, worker participation, risk assessments, musculoskeletal prevention, and organizational drivers/barriers across sectors and countries.
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.
